title: Demon Bikers and Dragon
description: A woman in a white bikini and black-and-white headscarf sits on a bed holding up a smartphone, taking a selfie. Through a large broken stone window behind her, three demonic figures on glowing motorcycles ride toward the viewer on a highway at dusk, while a large black dragon with green eyes breathes fire from the right side of the frame.
prompt: A surreal scene viewed through a broken stone archway, in the foreground a beautiful woman in a white string bikini and patterned headscarf sits on a bed taking a selfie with her phone, behind her three demonic bikers with horns and red skin ride glowing black motorcycles with neon lights down a highway at sunset, a massive black dragon with green eyes breathing orange fire on the right side, dramatic fantasy lighting, highly detailed digital art
